name: @pmndrs/og
description: Programmatic OG image generator — renders live three.js scenes, video and images to social cards using the pmndrs design tokens.

scripts.demo: tsx scripts/render.ts specs/demo-loop.json --mp4 --out ../demo/og/loop.mp4 && tsx scripts/render.ts specs/demo-loop.json --format jpeg --out ../demo/og/loop-poster.jpg && tsx scripts/render.ts specs/demo-gif.json --gif --fps 7.5 --out ../demo/og/loop.gif &&tsx scripts/render.ts specs/demo.json --manifest --format jpeg && tsx scripts/render.ts specs/demo-media.json --manifest --format jpeg
